verification_depth.standalone: Ed25519 signature, signed inventory, byte hashes and report anchors; standard library plus OpenSSL.
verification_depth.main: Adds source-bound controls, observations, findings, comparisons, snapshots, workflows and supported report semantics.
verification_depth.trust: Authenticate the public key separately. Neither verifier proves remote execution truth, operator identity or trusted time.

known_limits: Local, single-operator suite; no hosted multi-user RBAC or C2.
Imported scanner assertions and product/version matches remain hints until an explicitly authorized controlled check establishes evidence.
Curated declarative checks only; no arbitrary plugin code or autonomous exploitation chain.
Discovery requests only explicitly authorized operations and targets; observed surface is not a completeness claim.
Oracle projections may attest evaluation of discarded response data; signatures do not reconstruct discarded raw responses.
Standards references describe partial evidence mappings, not certification.
No independent head-to-head competitor benchmark or universal scanner replacement is claimed.
Public demonstrations use synthetic disposable loopback fixtures.

release_media.scope: Screen-capture concept and draft channel copy.
release_media.completion_evidence: A produced film or posted message requires its own artifact and publication receipt; neither is asserted by this contract.

publication_requirements: Complete same-source unit, integration, eight browser, demo, isolated wheel and package gates remain mandatory.
Exact version 1.5.0 and exact-commit CI must pass before publishing the immutable v1.5.0 tag; published asset checksums and availability must then be verified.

verification_contract.scope: 1.5.0 release scope; publication requires an exact-commit gate receipt and verified published assets.
verification_contract.results_source: Execution outcomes, source binding and log hashes belong to the actual verification receipt; this metadata does not assert gate success.
